Instructions

In this experiment, you will see 2 images of real world objects on each trial.
Your task is to determine which image appears larger or smaller on the screen.

You will be asked to complete 3 blocks of trials:

1. Practice block (get familiar with the task)
2. Larger image block (select the image that appears larger)
3. Smaller image block (select the image that appears smaller)

Each trial will begin with a fixation cross (+), followed by the images.

To respond, you will press z to choose the left image, and m to choose the right image.
Before starting, place your left index finger on z and right index finger on m.
Press any key to begin.

Practice Trials


You will complete two practice trials and receive feedback.

Instructions will appear on the screen.
If your response is incorrect, you must repeat the trial until correct.

Press z to choose the left image, and m to choose the right image.
